review_scope: Prepared lesson, fictional inputs and actual outputs from source-bound regression cases, including visual review. Fixed model contributions are test-only. This is not human learner acceptance, native voice/two-window acceptance, or professional approval.

editorial.purpose_and_first_use: The lesson teaches producing and presenting a short source-based HTML deck. It starts with the staff meeting objective and audience, then covers the entire first-use cycle rather than a layout feature.
editorial.inputs_and_request: Each locale has the short fictional brief and an ordinary-language request specifying problem, proposal, roles, decision and speaker notes. No prepared output or authored content ledger is shipped as the lesson answer.
editorial.execution_and_checkpoints: The working chat follows the current composer and builder; the voice chat explains actual progress. Checkpoints ask the learner to name the audience/decision and trace one displayed message to a source note.
editorial.deliverable_and_next_action: The learner opens the actual standalone HTML, uses arrows and speaker notes, checks the final decision and keeps the editable package. Browser QA covered navigation, overview, notes, reduced motion and print at four viewports.
editorial.practice_and_repeat: The exercise adds an audience-change note and a concrete incomplete request. The learner asks for a second deck, preserves the first, and explains how the new audience changed the result. Repeat instructions name sources, audience, purpose and language.
editorial.language_and_pacing: Italian instructions use concrete verbs (fornire, aprire, confrontare) and the same fictional names as the slides. The proposal remains a proposal in the notes and visible closing slide. The six lesson segments total 390 seconds; the guide allows additional processing and question time. No human timed session has been observed.

demo.result_review: Five slides follow the brief: proposal, incomplete requests, four process steps, Sara/Paolo responsibilities and a decision about a trial. Source/claim linkage and proposed status were reviewed. No measured outcome is claimed. Fresh native execution produced the same HTML bytes as the visually reviewed four-viewport browser QA result.

practice.result_review: The six-slide version adds the incomplete-request example for new colleagues and asks for details without diagnosing a fault. The original proposal and roles remain visible. The new audience produces an actual changed deck. Fresh native execution produced the same HTML bytes as the visually reviewed four-viewport browser QA result.
